planets.name: WASP-69 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-69 with a 3.87-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-69 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-69. Its orbit and size follow Allart et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
